designSummary: Repository assessment for goal 'Build a website about sport': this repo is a VS Code extension/orchestration tool, not a web application starter. It contains TypeScript extension code under src/, a webview asset under media/, and AI workflow assets. It is suitable for orchestrating or documenting delivery of a sports website, but not an ideal base for implementing the website itself. Preferred approach is to keep this repo as the orchestrator and create the sports website as a separate frontend project/repository or, if constrained to one repo, as a clearly isolated subproject outside src/ with its own package/build/deploy pipeline. Implementation should wait for scope clarification.
designDecisions: Decision: Do not treat the existing VS Code extension codebase as the application foundation for the sports website. The repository's primary architecture, packaging, and runtime target are VS Code extension delivery, not public website hosting.

Decision: Recommended target architecture for the sports website is a separate frontend application (preferably a modern SPA/SSR app such as Next.js/React or similar) with optional lightweight backend/CMS depending on content and dynamic needs. This repo may remain as planning/orchestration support only.

Decision: No implementation should begin until core product requirements are clarified, including site purpose, page set, content model, need for live scores/news/auth/admin, hosting target, SEO expectations, and whether delivery must occur inside this repository or may use a separate repo/subproject.
